# ShowEntire

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders its child only where the child fits whole, and never splits it.

Where [`PreventPageBreak`](prevent-page-break.md) moves an oversized child to the next page and still splits it if it fits on no page, `ShowEntire` refuses to split under any circumstance. A child taller than a whole content box therefore renders from the top of a fresh page and is cut off at the page boundary - the content that did not fit is dropped, not carried over.

Use it for content that is meaningless in pieces - a signature block, a certificate panel, a scorecard - where half the thing on each of two pages is worse than a shorter thing on one.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `PaginationWrapperBase`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new ShowEntire()
new ShowEntire(options: ShowEntireOptions)
new ShowEntire(child: IElement)
```
